name: Clone user
description: Copy one user's whole stored state into another account on this venue, as stored and sharing structure: workspace, agents and their sessions, jobs, assets, operations, HITL inbox and secrets. Secrets that are keys are copied too, so the clone reaches whatever they unlock; the DLFS drive key among them means the clone reads and writes the source's drives. The target is registered when absent and must otherwise hold no user state; its agents' wakes are re-armed. Refused while the source has a job not yet finished or an agent task outstanding. Requires venue-issued user/import on <venueDID>/users, and user/export there unless the source is the caller.

from.description: Exact DID of the user to copy

to.description: Exact DID of the account to fill

created.description: True when the clone registered the target
